description: Search live remote job listings by role, skill or company. Pass the job seeker's country to get only jobs they can legally take from where they live.

country.description:
Where the job seeker lives: a country name or ISO code ("Kenya", "KE").
When given, only jobs that person can legally take are returned.

limit.description: How many jobs to return, 1 to 20 (default 10).

query.description: Role, skill or company, e.g. "react developer", "customer support", "Canonical".

name: search_remote_jobs
